sources.scope: Enclosure-side oblique: flared tub, three visible red strip groups, external orange case, blue front-corner hardware and low metal strip.
Yellow-handle end: tub width, molded end recess, yellow attachment, two white lights, blue side hardware, black bumper and red detail.
Opposite-side oblique: tapered tub and floor ribs, longer rear overhang, strip lights and low silver strip.
